title: Your Life in 2035: What's Your Future Story?
description: Step into the future! Answer 12 questions to discover what your life looks like in 2035 and what destiny has in store for you.

questions.text: It's 2035. You wake up in your ideal home. Where is it?

options.text: A cozy apartment in a bustling megacity
A peaceful house in the countryside
A modern home in a quiet suburban neighborhood
A floating home or houseboat, traveling between places

questions.text: What's your typical morning routine in 2035?

options.text: Early workout, healthy breakfast, then work from home
Quick coffee, then head to a vibrant co-working space
Meditate in nature, enjoy a slow breakfast
Check emails from different time zones while traveling

questions.text: What does your career look like in 2035?

options.text: Leading innovative projects at a tech company
Running my own sustainable business or farm
Working remotely for multiple international clients
Consulting or speaking, traveling to share knowledge

questions.text: How do you spend your weekends in 2035?

options.text: Exploring new restaurants, art galleries, and city events
Hiking, gardening, or tending to my green space
Family gatherings and neighborhood activities
Taking short trips to nearby cities or countries

questions.text: What technology plays the biggest role in your 2035 life?

options.text: AI assistants and smart home systems
Sustainable tech and eco-monitoring devices
VR/AR for work and entertainment
Personal drone delivery and autonomous vehicles

questions.text: Your social life in 2035 looks like...

options.text: Large network of professional contacts and friends
Small close-knit circle of lifelong friends
Mix of online communities and local meetups
Friends scattered across the globe, digital connections

questions.text: What's your approach to health and wellness in 2035?

options.text: High-tech fitness tracking and biohacking
Organic living, clean eating, natural wellness
Balanced routine with regular checkups and moderate exercise
Adventure sports and active travel to stay fit

questions.text: What do you value most in your 2035 life?

options.text: Success, recognition, and professional achievement
Peace, tranquility, and harmony with nature
Family, community, and lasting relationships
Freedom, adventure, and new experiences

questions.text: How do you typically travel in 2035?

options.text: Hyperloop or high-speed rail between cities
Electric self-driving cars for scenic routes
Sustainable bicycles and walking in my neighborhood
Private planes or luxury travel packages
Built a successful company or reached C-suite
Created a sustainable sanctuary or farm
Raised a happy family and built a loving home
Explored the world and documented my adventures

questions.text: How do you stay informed about the world in 2035?

options.text: Real-time news apps and social media trends
Documentaries and nature publications
Community newsletters and local news
International podcasts and global news networks

questions.text: Looking back at your 2035 life, you feel...

options.text: Proud of my achievements and impact
Grateful for peace and fulfillment
Content with a balanced and happy life
Excited for all the adventures yet to come

results.title: The Urban Visionary
results.description: In 2035, you're living your best life in the heart of a thriving megacity! You've embraced the fast-paced urban lifestyle and become a leader in your field. Your days are filled with innovative projects, networking events, and the electric energy of city life. You've built a powerful professional network and made a name for yourself as someone who shapes the future. Your ambition drives you to constantly push boundaries and achieve new heights of success.
results.tip: Remember to occasionally slow down and enjoy the moment—success is sweeter when you savor it!

results.title: The Nature Harmony
results.description: In 2035, you've found your paradise in harmony with nature! Whether it's a sustainable farm, a forest retreat, or an eco-friendly sanctuary, you've created a life that aligns with the earth. Your days are filled with the simple pleasures of growing your own food, tending to your garden, and breathing fresh air. You've prioritized sustainability and wellness, becoming an inspiration to others who dream of a more organic lifestyle. Your peace comes from living in tune with nature.
results.tip: Stay connected with the world beyond nature—your wisdom can inspire positive change everywhere!

results.title: The Family Anchor
results.description: In 2035, you've built the perfect suburban life! With a beautiful home in a friendly neighborhood, you've created a warm and loving environment for your family. Your life revolves around community activities, family gatherings, and meaningful relationships. You've found the perfect balance between work and personal life, with a focus on creating lasting memories. Your home is always open to friends and loved ones, making you the heart of your community.
results.tip: Don't forget to chase some personal dreams too—your family will cheer you on!

results.title: The Global Adventurer
results.description: In 2035, the world is your home! You've embraced a life of constant movement, traveling between countries and experiencing diverse cultures. Your passport is well-stamped, and your stories are legendary. Whether you're working remotely from exotic locations or pursuing adventure tourism, you've rejected the traditional 9-to-5 lifestyle in favor of freedom and exploration. You've met incredible people from all walks of life and have stories that captivate everyone you meet.
results.tip: Don't forget to create a home base—every adventurer needs a place to return to!

scoringRules.dimensionCalculation: Sum scores for each future type, highest score determines the result
scoringRules.tiebreakerRule: If tied, choose the type that appears more consistently across answers
scoringRules.percentageDisplay: Show percentage for each future type (e.g., City: 45% | Nature: 25% | Suburb: 20% | Travel: 10%)
